data_role: aggregate source data; no patient rows

mimic_split.stage: all 448804 same-source MIMIC-IV-ED 1.0 encounters before score/action complete-case filtering

mimic_response.rule: positive if any observed 1; negative if all four observed 0; otherwise missing
mimic_response.nonbinary_components: treated as missing in this analysis
mimic_response.eligibility: same-source ED 1.0 cohort; no legacy linkage eligibility mask

candidate.capacity_role: Low reference alert count; not measured hospital capacity

action_probability.prediction: linear interpolation at the observed score with endpoint clipping
action_probability.sensitivity: assign to development-origin width-3 bins before interpolation
action_probability.bootstrap_unit: patient cluster, all eligible encounters per sampled patient
action_probability.bootstrap_conditioning: learning curve and comparator predictions fixed
action_probability.bootstrap_sampling: sorted eligible patient IDs; default_rng multinomial cluster multiplicities; fixed predictions

prepared_inputs.action_windows: MIMIC lactate/vasopressor 48 h, steroid 24 h, inherited fluid 12 h positive-record flag; Stanford fluid >=2000 mL in 6 h
